parts.text: Deliveries carry a load from one site to another, while inspections take a drone with the right sensors to a list of points in a set order and bring it back to where the inspection started. Drones are of several models from different manufacturers, differing in how much they can carry, how far they can fly on a full battery, which sensors they carry, and which charging connector they use. Software never chooses a drone or a way for us, and I want help finding out which of our drones could get to where a job starts.
